resale_co.name: Residential Resale Inspection / Resale Certificate
resale_co.issued_by: Southampton Township Office of Construction, Zoning and Land Development
resale_co.lead_time: Application and fee must be received at least 14 days before the settlement date
requirements: Smoke alarms on each level of the home and within 10 feet of any sleeping room
Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of any sleeping room
House number at least 3 inches, visible from the street
Guard rails and handrails secure and steady, no missing spindles
Yard free of trash, grass cut, brush and weeds not overgrown
Doors and windows in good working condition
No open electric outlets, switches or lights; electric panel cover in place with no missing blanks
No open holes in walls or ceilings
Appliance venting in place and free of defects
Burlington County recycling receptacle stays at the property
resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the 2026 Residential Resale Inspection Application from the Construction & Zoning page and submit it with the fee to the Construction Office, 5 Retreat Road, at least 14 days before settlement. Questions and inspection requests go to construction@southamptonnj.org. Payment method is not stated on the form.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official, Building Subcode Official (handles resale inspections)

evidence.quote: APPLICATION MUST BE RECEIVED WITH FEE AT LEAST 14 DAYS PRIOR TO SETTLEMENT DATE

A RESALE CERTIFICATE WILL ONLY BE ISSUED WHEN THE PREMISES INSPECTED ARE CONSISTENT WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF N.J.S.A.52:27D-198.1, N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19 AND CHAPTER 8 OF THE SOUTHAMPTON PROPERTY MAINTENANCE CODE.
OFFICE OF CONSTRUCTION, ZONING AND LAND DEVELOPMENT 5 Retreat Road 609-859-2786
Tom Boyd, Construction Official, Building Subcode Official, Building, Resale Inspections

Whenever there is a change of occupancy of any building subject to the requirements of this section, no owner shall sell, lease or otherwise permit occupancy for residential purposes of that building without first obtaining from the township building inspector a certificate evidencing compliance with the requirements of this section.

An owner who sells, leases, rents or otherwise permits to be occupied for residential purposes any premises subject to the provisions of this section without complying with the inspection and certification requirements hereof shall be subject to a fine not more than $500

resale_co.notes: Township Code §8-8 (Smoke Alarms, read through the ecode360 print view) bars an owner from selling a one- or two-family home without first getting a certificate from the township building inspector, with a $50 fee and $25 per reinspection and a fine of up to $500 for noncompliance. The July 21, 2026 Residential Resale Inspection Application uses the same fees, must be filed 14 days before settlement, and issues a resale certificate against the state smoke/CO alarm law (N.J.S.A. 52:27D-198.1, N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19) and Chapter 8 of the township property maintenance code, so the check is broader than smoke alarms. Tom Boyd (Construction Official, Building Subcode Official, resale inspections) works Monday to Thursday, 9 am to 3 pm. Rental properties have separate rental registration and rental inspection forms (rental program, not a resale item).

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level and within 10 feet of any sleeping room
CO alarms within 10 feet of any sleeping room
The July 2026 township form does not list a fire extinguisher

authorities.name: Southampton Township Construction Office (township building inspector issues the smoke alarm certificate under Township Code §8-8; NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: Smoke and CO alarms are checked during the Residential Resale Inspection (one $50 per unit application, see the resale certificate section); file the application with the fee at least 14 days before settlement. No separate smoke certificate form or fee was found.
authorities.contact_title: Construction Official, Building Subcode Official (handles resale inspections)

SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name:Southhampton T wp Constr Office Addr: 5 Retreat Rd Southhampton NJ 08088 Phone (609) 859-2786
Smoke detectors required on each level of the home & within 10 feet of any sleeping room
Carbon Monoxide detectors are required to be within 10 feet of any sleeping room
This section implements the provisions of P.L. 1991, c.92 to require installation of at least one smoke detector on each level of one- and two-family homes when a change of occupancy occurs.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Southampton (LEA registry code S), but the DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Southampton without the SC (smoke certs) flag, the state directory (Vincentown and Hampton Lakes fire company pages) names the Southampton Township Construction Office, 5 Retreat Rd, (609) 859-2786, for smoke detector compliance, and Township Code §8-8 makes the township building inspector issue the sale certificate. The $50 / $25 code fees are the same as the resale inspection fees and appear to be one combined charge. The July 2026 township form does not list a fire extinguisher, in line with P.L.2025, c.19.

other_items.label: County recycling receptacle
other_items.detail: The Burlington County recycling receptacle must stay at the property; contact the Recycling Coordinator (recyclingcoordinator@southamptonnj.org, 609-859-5574) if one is needed.

other_items.label: Utilities on for inspection
other_items.detail: All utilities must be on for the resale inspection.

open_questions: Payment method, certificate validity period and any rush fee are not stated.
Confirm the $50 resale inspection is a single charge covering both the resale certificate and the smoke/CO certificate.
